title: Bug : stopped loop = continuous red line
body:
Recent beta. Half asleep,  I set by error sport mode (profile and TT change), then stopped it and set a new profile and maybe did something else as suddenly I saw the red loop stopped icon. I set it back ON. Then I remarked the red line as if the loop was stopped all along (which is not the case as I had SMBs and basal changes).

Look around 00:40 in the logs.
